svg.text: AB763 Super Reverb-style · eyelet board layout (derived)

Redrawn from Fender 'SUPER-REVERB-AMP AB763' schematic (drawing code C-FD, cited in meta.yaml) — layout DERIVED from that circuit drawing; no factory board-layout sheet for this circuit was located — not a trace
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
